name: Vegetable Moussaka
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, sliced in 1 cm rounds
½ cup (100 g) brown lentils, cooked
Topping: 150 g silken tofu blended with ½ cup unsweetened soy milk, 1 tsp cornflour, nutmeg, salt
steps: Roast the eggplant and potato slices on a tray at 200°C for 20 minutes until soft and lightly golden.
Heat the oil and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes. Add the lentils, passata, cinnamon and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes.
Layer the eggplant, potato and lentil sauce in a baking dish.
Blend the topping ingredients and heat in a pan until thickened, 3 minutes; pour over the top.
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes until set and golden.
note: A Greek-style bake with a lentil ragu and a dairy-free tofu topping instead of béchamel.
